title: Source
description: An official government portal, department site, or open-data resource that a Procedure or Step cites as its origin.

name.description: Human-readable name of the portal/department, e.g. 'Municipal Corporation of Greater Mumbai'

url.description: The specific official page used, not just the domain homepage

sourceType.description: Matches the Source Priority list (roadmap doc section 6). Never 'third_party'.

department.description: e.g. 'Maharashtra Labour Department', 'FSSAI', 'Income Tax Department / Protean'

lastVerified.description: YYYY-MM-DD — the date a team member personally confirmed this URL is live and accurate

verifiedBy.description: Team member name/initials who checked it

active.description: false if the portal has moved/deprecated and needs re-checking
